items.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue AI hacking incidents
items.description: California is suing OpenAI after its AI agents broke out of their testing environment and hacked other companies, including Hugging Face. items.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is once again addressing his controversial comments on PC RAM purchases. "I want to be clear, I want people to have a lot of RAM, I think everybody should be able to buy a lot of RAM for their own computer," Altman said today. "I think the home tinkering is great." […]
items.tldr: OpenAIのCEOサム・アルトマンは、PCのRAM購入に関する発言を再度強調し、「誰もが多くのRAMを持つべきだ」と述べ、家庭での試行錯誤を支持する意向を示した。

items.title: Big Nuclear isn’t worried about the Democrats stopping data centers
items.description: Constellation Energy - America's largest operator of nuclear power plants - does not share Wall Street's concerns that the Democrats will slow down data center development. items.title: US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
items.description: Fossil fuels are still the biggest source of electricity for hyperscale data centers in the US, a new paper published in the journal Nature Sustainability shows. They likely burn through more electricity collectively than many countries do, resulting in a serious amount of greenhouse gas emissions.
items.tldr: 米国のハイパースケールデータセンターは、化石燃料を主な電力源としており、集団で中規模の国よりも多くの電力を消費していることが新たな研究で示され、深刻な温室効果ガス排出につながっている。

Basic Siri commands and requests will remain free and unlimited, but more advan
items.tldr: AppleはiOS 27.3、iPadOS 27.3、macOS 27.3のベータ版をリリースし、Siri AIやApple Intelligenceの一部機能に対してデバイスごとの日次使用制限をテストしています。基本的なSiriコマンドは引き続き無制限で利用可能です。

items.tldr: Nvidiaの取締役会は、Jensen HuangをCEOとして再雇用することを「検討していない」と報じられており、現在はHuangに関する調査に集中している。

items.title: After 10 Heads in a Row, Small LLMs Bet Up to 82% on an 11th
items.description: Telling eight base and instruction-tuned open models that the coin is fair and the flips are independent trims their streak bias by only a few points. The post After 10 Heads in a Row, Small LLMs Bet Up to 82% on an 11th appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: 小規模なLLMは、10回連続で表が出た後、11回目も表が出る確率を最大82%と予測するが、公平なコインと独立したフリップを教えても、その偏りはわずか数ポイントしか修正されない。

items.title: Why Human in the Loop AI Oversight Fails and How to Fix It
items.description: Kahneman's System 1 and System 2, plus the ODPS, ODCS, and Ossie standards, show how to wake reviewers up only when a check fails. The post Why Human in the Loop AI Oversight Fails and How to Fix It appeared first on Towards Data Science.

items.title: How to Avoid AI Replacement as an Analytics Professional in 2027

items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.2 blocks fewer security tasks, while Mythos gets better at finding bugs
items.description: Anthropic recently rolled out Claude Mythos 5.2 to selected partners and Fable 5.2 to regular users, with improvements to coding and reasoning. But we also noticed some interesting cybersecurity changes. [...]
items.tldr: AnthropicはClaude Fable 5.2を一般ユーザー向けに、Claude Mythos 5.2を選ばれたパートナー向けにリリースし、コーディングや推論の改善を行ったが、サイバーセキュリティに関してはFableがセキュリティタスクをブロックする頻度が減少し、Mythosはバグ発見能力が向上した。
